differences: The preprint (v1, before the authors corrected their CPPS extraction script) gives AFM-group mean CPPS by phase of 15.39, 15.71, 15.93 and 15.91 dB; the shared, corrected file gives 15.34, 15.63, 15.82 and 15.91 dB. The published article was behind a paywall, so no CPPS statistic of the corrected analysis could be checked; the checks are the participant counts, ages, trial design and feedback settings.

The preprint describes z-scoring CPPS within each group over all data; the shared CPPS_z is standardised against each group's baseline phase (an exact linear transform of CPPS, baseline mean 0 and SD 1).
